description: Quote opening a leveraged position: expected collateral, debt, health factor and liquidation price. Returns a quote envelope; `expiresAt` is unix ms and quotes expire after 180 seconds. Amounts are base-unit integer strings.

borrowToken.description: Disambiguates strategies that share strategyId and collateral

leverage.description: Target leverage as a plain number between 1.01 and 100: 3 means 3x (not 1e18 fixed-point). An open must borrow, so 1 is not accepted; to add collateral without borrowing, adjust an existing position

slippage.description: Slippage tolerance as a decimal: 0.005 means 0.5% (not 1e18 fixed-point)

name: quote_open
title: Quote open
